commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak score of 26 and the Nifty 50 logging four consecutive distribution sessions ahead of the RBI policy meeting, Stan Weinstein's stage discipline demands extreme defensiveness. When the general market trend is under distribution, William O’Neil and Jesse Livermore taught that three out of four stocks follow the prevailing tide. Breakouts in a weak tape carry a high failure rate, making aggressive exposure reckless. Minervini's progressive exposure rule dictates holding fire until the market proves itself. Capital must be preserved, position sizes curtailed, and stops kept razor-tight. Only exceptional Stage 2 leaders displaying accelerating earnings and resilient relative strength warrant close monitoring on institutional pivots.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades near the 104.09 pivot with 2× volume and aligned swing lows above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. However, overhead supply from prolonged basing dampens follow-through quality, while poor relative strength against sector peers reflects absent institutional sponsorship.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Q1 FY27 was poor with revenue falling 56.3% and net profit dropping 25.6% YoY. Operating margins hover below 2%, while return metrics remain depressed with ROCE at 5.58% and 3-year ROE near 3.1%. Inadequate growth and weak profitability fail CANSLIM standards.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Violation of 97.24 pivot stop invalidates base support; exit immediately as deteriorating fundamentals offer zero buffer in a weak market.

ADFFOODS.technical: Confirmed SEPA breakout clearing 20-session resistance on 2.74× average volume. Price holds cleanly above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI 56 shows constructive, non-extended momentum. While market distribution creates headwind risk, chart pattern demonstrates genuine accumulation off intermediate support.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Solid top-line momentum with Q1 FY27 revenue up 25.9% YoY to ₹167 Cr, while net profit grew 13.4%. Healthy OPM near 17.7%, ROCE above 21%, and virtually debt-free balance sheet confirm sound financial health, though EPS acceleration remains below O'Neil's 25% hurdle.
ADFFOODS.risk: Close below 309.63 stop triggers risk protocol, voiding the breakout pivot and warning of broad market distribution drag.

AEGISLOG.technical: Textbook Stage 2 power trend exhibiting a classic 3-up sequence off 21-EMA and 50-DMA support with expanding volume. Strong relative strength persists as price trades comfortably above all moving averages. RSI 58 provides ideal momentum cushion without short-term exhaustion.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Outstanding CANSLIM fundamentals as liquid terminal expansions boosted Q1 FY27 EPS by 269% and sales by 37.1% YoY. Sustained EBITDA margin expansion, ROCE near 19.8%, and moderate debt-to-equity (~0.40) validate strong institutional backing.
AEGISLOG.risk: Break below 1383.26 compromises the 21-EMA power trend structure; sell immediately to enforce capital protection.

ALICON.technical: Decisive 20-day high breakout registered on massive 10.48× average volume. Price cleared intermediate overhead resistance and is trending above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. MACD is positive above signal and zero line, signaling forceful momentum initiation.
ALICON.fundamental: Order book wins drove Q1 FY27 revenue up 38.3% YoY to ₹578 Cr, while EPS rebounded +22.9% YoY. While raw material inflation capped EBITDA margins at 9.5% and ROCE sits at 11.2%, cyclical turnaround in earnings provides fundamental traction.
ALICON.risk: Breach of 790.64 invalidates the 10× volume breakout bar, signaling institutional rejection and requiring prompt stop execution.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Constructive double-bottom base with price consolidating above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI 64 exhibits resilient relative strength. Small-range inside candle at the 953.70 neckline pivot denotes tight volatility compression (VCP) awaiting decisive volume confirmation.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Exceptional Q1 FY27 operating performance with revenue surging 111.2% to ₹87.8 Cr and net profit jumping 151.2% YoY. Negligible debt, superior ROCE of 29.6%, and 21% ROE provide pristine fundamental support under CANSLIM parameters.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Decline below 849.35 breaks double-bottom support and moving average alignment; cut losses quickly without hesitation.

ATLANTAELE.technical: Bullish double-bottom pattern clearing neckline pressure with an engulfing candle on 3.2× volume expansion. Stock holds firmly above 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA, displaying counter-cyclical relative strength in a favored capital goods theme.
ATLANTAELE.fundamental: Robust demand for power transformers drove Q1 FY27 revenue up 48.0% and EPS up 40.0% YoY. Balance sheet became fully debt-free with zero term debt in FY26, backed by a strong ₹2,493 Cr order book and high ROCE.
ATLANTAELE.risk: Breakdown below 1804.62 violates swing-low support and the 21-EMA; execute stop immediately to curtail downside risk.
